/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.question: How do I get started with your platform?
/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.answer: Getting started is easy! Simply create an account, connect your WhatsApp Business API, and you'll be ready to send messages and manage conversations within minutes. Our setup wizard will guide you through each step.

/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.question: What are your support hours?
/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.answer: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM (EST). For urgent issues outside business hours, you can reach us via email and we'll respond within 24 hours.

/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.question: How can I track my campaign performance?
/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.answer: Navigate to the Analytics dashboard to view real-time metrics including delivery rates, open rates, click-through rates, and customer engagement. You can filter by date range, campaign type, and audience segments.

/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.question: Can I automate my WhatsApp messages?
/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.answer: Yes! Our automation engine lets you create message flows with triggers, conditions, and actions. Set up welcome messages, follow-ups, appointment reminders, and more using our visual flow builder.

/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.question: How do I manage my contact lists?
/api/training/9b073b52-38d2-48ff-bb81-c6.answer: You can import contacts via CSV, add them manually, or sync from your CRM. Organize contacts into groups, apply tags, and segment your audience for targeted campaigns.
